text: What is a VLAN, stated precisely?
choices: A group of ports with the same speed
A broadcast domain, so traffic between VLANs must be routed
A security policy applied to a switch
A virtual cable between two switches
explanation: Creating a VLAN creates a broadcast domain, and traffic between VLANs must be routed exactly as if they were physically separate networks — because logically they are. Failing to internalise this produces the most common VLAN misconfiguration: VLANs created, ports assigned, and no routing configured.
